title: Spec approval record
description: Hash-bound approval written when a human approves a frozen spec. It proves the freeze: the SHA-256 of the spec, of every contract and accepted ADR it references and of every test file the gates name. Any later change of a hashed file voids it. Map keys are POSIX relative paths. The approval is typed by the human as `approve <spec id> <first 12 hex of the spec's sha256>`; the record keeps that prefix and it must match the spec hash. The prompt_excerpt starts with that phrase after any leading whitespace (the keyword and the hex in any case, the spec id exactly), so a sentence that merely contains it, such as do not approve ..., is no approval.

approved_spec_sha256_prefix.description: The first 12 characters of spec_sha256, as typed in the approval phrase `approve <spec id> <first 12 hex of the spec's sha256>` (captured from the human's prompt, or by `spec approve`); it must equal spec_sha256[:12].

contracts_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every contract file the spec references, keyed by POSIX relative path.

adrs_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every accepted ADR the spec references, keyed by POSIX relative path.
